guild.description:
A guild about solitaire boardgaming and the 1 Player podcast.


The podcast
The show comes out between every 2 to 5 weeks (so far). Each episode features some sort of discussion relevant to solo gaming and a game review.

The show can be found at http://fractaloon.podbean.com.
